name: Stipendium Hungaricum Scholarship Programme
host_institution: Hungarian State Universities (ELTE, BME, Debrecen, Szeged)

funding.tuition: 100% Full Tuition Exemption
funding.accommodation: Free dormitory placement or monthly housing allowance (HUF 40,000)
funding.monthly_stipend: HUF 43,700 for Undergrad/Master, HUF 140,000 for PhD
funding.health_insurance: Full Hungarian National Health Insurance (TAJ Card)

language.notes: Min 5.5 in each band or institutional English exam.

description: Hungary's flagship bilateral scholarship with 400 reserved seats for Pakistani students nominated via HEC (200 Bachelor's, 100 Master's, 70 One-Tier Master's, 30 PhD).

basic_details.scholarship_name: Stipendium Hungaricum Scholarship Programme
basic_details.offering_entity: Hungarian Government (Tempus Public Foundation / Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Trade) & Government of Pakistan (HEC)
basic_details.host_institutions_covered: Hungarian State Universities (Eötvös Loránd University - ELTE, Budapest University of Technology - BME, University of Debrecen, University of Szeged, Corvinus, University of Pécs, MATE)
basic_details.major_restrictions: Eligible for almost all fields of study: Engineering, Computer Science, Natural Sciences, Medicine, Dentistry, Pharmacy, Agriculture, Business, Social Sciences, Arts and Humanities.
basic_details.number_of_awards_total: ~5,000 scholarship holders admitted annually worldwide from 90+ sending partners
basic_details.number_of_awards_pakistan: 400 reserved bilateral quota seats for Pakistani students annually (200 Bachelor's, 100 Master's, 70 One-Tier Master's/Medicine, 30 PhD)
basic_details.duration_of_scholarship: Bachelor's: 3-4 years; Master's: 1.5-2 years; One-Tier Master's (Medicine): 5-6 years; PhD: 4 years

nationality_requirements: Citizens of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan
eligibility_requirements.age_limit_notes: Must be at least 18 years old by 31 August of entry year. HEC Pakistan enforces age limits: max 22-24 for Bachelor's; max 35 for Master's/PhD (up to 40 for regular public sector/faculty).
eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: 12 years education (HSSC/A-Levels) for Bachelor's; 16 years education (BS/MA/MSc) for Master's; 18 years education (MS/MPhil) for PhD.
eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: Minimum 60% marks in annual system or 2.50/4.00 CGPA in semester system.
eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: Relevant pre-requisite courses matching the chosen Hungarian degree.
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Completed degrees; result-awaiting candidates can apply if final result is declared before HEC nomination deadline.
eligibility_requirements.work_experience_notes: Not required.
eligibility_requirements.language_notes: Varies by Hungarian university: IELTS 5.5 to 6.5, TOEFL iBT 72 to 90, or Duolingo 95+. Many Hungarian universities accept English Medium of Instruction (MOI) certificates from Pakistani universities or conduct their own online oral English interview.
eligibility_requirements.other_language_requirements: None required; 1 year Hungarian language preparatory option available.
eligibility_requirements.special_eligibility_categories: Candidates must be formally nominated by the Higher Education Commission (HEC) Pakistan.
eligibility_requirements.previous_scholarship_restrictions: Previous Stipendium Hungaricum scholarship holders who re-apply within the same study level are restricted.

tuition_fee.details: 100% exemption from the payment of tuition fees for the entire duration of the degree program.

admission_application_fee.details: No university application fee when applying through the Stipendium Hungaricum system.

accommodation.details: Free university dormitory placement OR a monthly housing allowance of HUF 40,000/month towards private accommodation.

monthly_stipend.details: Monthly living stipend paid directly by the Hungarian host university for 12 months a year.
monthly_stipend.amount: HUF 43,700/mo for Undergrad/Master; HUF 140,000/mo (Phase 1) and HUF 180,000/mo (Phase 2) for PhD (~PKR 35,000 to 145,000/mo)

airfare.details: International airfare between Pakistan and Hungary is NOT covered by the Hungarian government (must be paid by student or HEC).

visa_fee.details: Type D Hungarian Student Visa application fee is WAIVED for Stipendium Hungaricum scholarship holders at the Hungarian Embassy in Islamabad.

health_insurance.details: Hungarian National Health Insurance (TAJ Card) providing full medical services under Hungarian law, plus supplementary private health insurance up to HUF 65,000/year.

food_allowance.details: Subsidized meals available at university canteens.

books_and_materials_allowance.details: Covered via stipend or campus library access.

research_funding_conference_grant.details: University departmental doctoral grants available for PhD candidates.

travel_transit_allowance.details: Local transport in Budapest/Debrecen purchased at heavily discounted student rate (~HUF 3,450/month).

university_and_program_options.single_or_multiple_universities: Applicants may select up to TWO study programs (at either 2 different universities or the same university) in order of preference (Priority 1 and Priority 2).
participating_institutions: ELTE Budapest, BME, University of Debrecen, University of Szeged, Corvinus Budapest, University of Pécs, MATE, Óbuda University, Széchenyi István University
university_and_program_options.university_rankings_scope: Top 1 to 10 universities in Hungary; QS World Rankings 500-1000.
university_and_program_options.program_duration: Bachelor's: 3-4 years; Master's: 1.5-2 years; One-tier Master's: 5-6 years; PhD: 4 years
university_and_program_options.admission_requirements_summary: Online application, transcripts, medical certificate, motivation letter, institutional online exam / Skype interview.
university_and_program_options.easiest_hardest_institutions_guidance: Single application through DreamApply portal; institutional entrance exams are held online in April/May.
university_and_program_options.strategic_program_match_advice: Priority 1 choice receives maximum focus from universities; ensure Priority 1 is your strongest academic alignment.

application_process_roadmap.portal_system_name: DreamApply Online Application System & HEC Scholarship Portal (scholarship.hec.gov.pk)
application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: MANDATORY DUAL SUBMISSION: 1) Register and apply on the Hungarian DreamApply portal; AND 2) Register and apply on the HEC Pakistan Scholarship portal.
step_by_step_workflow: 1. Register on Tempus DreamApply portal (opens mid-November).
2. Select 2 study programs in order of preference.
3. Upload transcripts, certificates, medical certificate, motivation letter, and passport.
4. Submit DreamApply application by January 15 deadline.
5. Register on HEC Pakistan Scholarship portal (scholarship.hec.gov.pk).
6. Fill HEC online profile and submit under 'Stipendium Hungaricum' category.
7. Take HEC USAT (for Undergrad) or HEC HAT (for Master's/PhD) aptitude test.
8. HEC prepares national merit list based on academic formula (50%) + HAT/USAT score (50%).
9. HEC nominates top 400 candidates (+ reserve list) to Tempus Public Foundation in February.
10. Nominated candidates take online entrance examinations/interviews with Hungarian universities (March - May).
11. Tempus Public Foundation issues final Letters of Award in June/July.
12. Apply for Hungarian Type D Visa at Embassy in Islamabad and depart in September.
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Integrated DreamApply routing + HEC national nomination.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Required for PhD applicants (2 letters of recommendation from professors with doctoral degrees); not mandatory for Bachelor's/Master's.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Motivation Letter (minimum 1 page / 4,000 characters): Why Hungary, reasons for selecting specific programs, and career ambitions.
application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: PhD applicants must upload a detailed research plan (minimum 2 pages) and statement of supervisor acceptance.
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: Europass CV format.
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: Online institutional entrance exam (written test) followed by 10-15 minute oral interview via Skype/Teams conducted by Hungarian faculty professors.
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: HEC USAT (Undergrad) or HEC HAT (Postgrad) required for Pakistani nomination. Hungarian universities conduct their own subject tests.
application_process_roadmap.application_fee_amount: HUF 0 (Tempus application is free; HEC charges nominal test fee PKR 2,000 for HAT/USAT).
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: Degrees must be attested by HEC / IBCC and Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MOFA) prior to visa issuance.
application_process_roadmap.translation_requirements: Certified English translations if originals are in Urdu.
application_process_roadmap.final_submission_method: Dual online portal submission (DreamApply + HEC).

required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Signed electronically on the portal

required_documents_checklist.specification: Minimum 1 page detailing academic purpose and Hungarian context
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Address both Priority 1 and Priority 2 programs

required_documents_checklist.specification: Minimum 2-page detailed research proposal
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Mandatory for PhD candidates

important_dates_timeline.interview_period: March - May (Online entrance exams and Skype interviews)
important_dates_timeline.shortlist_announcement: HEC nomination in late February; Final awards in June/July
important_dates_timeline.annual_cycle_notes: Both DreamApply and HEC portal applications must be completed before their respective deadlines.

selection_process_and_weights.academic_weight: 40% (Matric, Inter, and Bachelor's marks calculated via HEC formula)
selection_process_and_weights.research_experience_weight: 15% (For PhD applicants; proposal review by Hungarian supervisors)
selection_process_and_weights.personal_statement_weight: 10% (Motivation letter quality)
selection_process_and_weights.interview_weight: 20% (Hungarian university institutional exam and oral interview score)
selection_process_and_weights.test_scores_weight: HEC USAT / HAT test accounts for 50% of the initial national nomination score in Pakistan!
selection_process_and_weights.selection_panel_composition: Stage 1: HEC Pakistan National Nomination Committee; Stage 2: Hungarian University Departmental Admissions Committees; Stage 3: Tempus Board of Trustees.
selection_process_and_weights.evaluation_methodology: HEC nominates candidate pool via academic + test merit; Hungarian universities examine candidates via online tests/interviews and give admission scores (Pass/Fail/Waitlist); Tempus confirms awards.

competitiveness_profile.total_annual_applicants: ~10,000 to 14,000 applicants in Pakistan across all degree levels
competitiveness_profile.total_scholarships_awarded: 400 principal awards exclusively reserved for Pakistan annually
competitiveness_profile.acceptance_rate_pakistan: ~2.8% to 4.0% (Moderate-High Competition, but largest European quota for Pakistan)
competitiveness_profile.typical_academic_and_research_profile: Solid grades in intermediate/bachelor's and strong score on HEC USAT/HAT test (typically 65+ out of 100).
competitiveness_profile.common_backgrounds_of_winners: FSc Pre-Medical and Pre-Engineering students (for BS and Medicine); graduates of UET, NUST, FAST, COMSATS, Punjab University, Karachi University.
competitiveness_profile.high_representation_countries: Reserved exclusively for Pakistan under bilateral cultural agreement.

fake_websites_and_scams: Agents in Lahore, Rawalpindi, and Karachi charging PKR 100,000 to 300,000 claiming they 'guarantee nomination on the HEC Hungary quota'. HEC nominations are strictly computerized and merit-based.
Unofficial portals charging application fees.
red_flags_and_warnings.application_fee_warning: DreamApply is completely FREE. HEC charges only the standard test registration fee for HAT/USAT (~PKR 2,000).
red_flags_and_warnings.agent_and_intermediary_warnings: Never hire an agent. All portals and communication are direct with the applicant.
hidden_costs_breakdown: International flight ticket to Budapest: NOT covered by Hungarian scholarship (PKR 180,000 to 250,000 one-way/return).
HEC & IBCC document attestation fees and MOFA apostille stamps (PKR 10,000 to 20,000).
Medical screening lab tests (HIV, Hepatitis, X-Ray: approx PKR 10,000 to 15,000).
Monthly stipend limitation: HUF 43,700 (~PKR 35,000/mo) for undergrad/master is tight; students often need modest personal pocket money support (~€100-€150/mo) or part-time work.
misleading_claims_debunked: MYTH: Flights are covered. (Fact: Airfare is explicitly the responsibility of the student).
MYTH: You cannot work in Hungary. (Fact: International students can legally work up to 30 hours/week during study term in Hungary).
official_vs_unofficial_discrepancies: Agents often fail to inform applicants about the mandatory HEC portal application; applying on DreamApply without applying on the HEC portal results in immediate disqualification for Pakistanis.

scholarship_obligations_and_terms.minimum_gpa_maintenance: Must earn at least 36 credits across every two consecutive semesters (or 18 credits per semester) according to Hungarian institutional regulations.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.attendance_requirements: Physical residence in Hungary mandatory. Being absent for more than 30 consecutive days without written permission leads to scholarship termination.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.academic_progress_monitoring: Semi-annual credit and attendance reports sent by universities to Tempus Public Foundation.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.work_restrictions_during_study: Students holding a Hungarian Residence Permit for Study purposes may work up to 30 hours per week during term-time and full-time during vacations.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.home_country_return_obligation: No mandatory home residency restriction enforced by Hungary; students can transition to Hungarian 9-month Job Seeker Residence Permit upon graduation or pursue PhDs across the EU.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.service_obligations_or_bonds: HEC Pakistan requires signing an undertaking form agreeing to return, though enforcement is non-statutory for self-funded travel.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.repayment_clawback_conditions: If a student drops out without certified medical emergency, scholarship funding and health insurance terminate immediately.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_university: Permitted ONCE during the scholarship tenure within the first year of studies, subject to approval by both Hungarian universities and Tempus.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_major: Permitted ONCE, strictly within the same sending partner quota and study level.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.extension_policy: Bachelor's and Master's programs can be extended by a maximum of 2 semesters upon written application and university approval (stipend is suspended during extension, but tuition remains waived).

name: DAAD Development-Related Postgraduate Courses (EPOS)
host_institution: German Partner Universities (TU Munich, RWTH Aachen, TU Berlin)

funding.tuition: 100% Free Tuition at Public Universities
funding.accommodation: Covered via monthly stipend
funding.monthly_stipend: EUR 934 for Master's, EUR 1,300 for PhD
funding.health_insurance: Full German statutory health & accident insurance covered
funding.settlement_allowance: EUR 460 one-off study allowance

language.notes: German language course (up to 6 months) included before study.

description: Premier German government scholarship for professionals with min 2 years experience.

basic_details.scholarship_name: DAAD Development-Related Postgraduate Courses (EPOS)
basic_details.offering_entity: German Academic Exchange Service (DAAD) & Federal Ministry for Economic Cooperation and Development (BMZ)
basic_details.host_institutions_covered: German State Universities (TU Munich, RWTH Aachen, TU Berlin, Univ of Bonn, Freiburg, Stuttgart, Leipzig, etc.)
basic_details.major_restrictions: Restricted strictly to accredited development-related postgraduate courses listed in the official DAAD EPOS brochure (Economic Sciences, Development Cooperation, Engineering, Regional Planning, Agriculture, Environmental Sciences, Medicine/Public Health, Social Sciences, Media).
basic_details.number_of_awards_total: ~300 to 500 scholarships awarded annually worldwide
basic_details.number_of_awards_pakistan: ~30 to 45 awards for Pakistan across various EPOS programs annually
basic_details.duration_of_scholarship: 12 to 24 months for Master's; up to 42 months for PhD

nationality_requirements: Citizens of developing countries on DAC list (Pakistan is fully eligible)
eligibility_requirements.age_limit_notes: No explicit age limit, but academic degree must NOT be older than 6 years at time of application.
eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: Completed undergraduate degree (4-year Bachelor's / 16 years education) with above-average results (typically upper third of class).
eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: German grade 2.5 or better (equivalent in Pakistan to ~3.0/4.0 CGPA or 70%+ marks).
eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: Academic background directly matching the chosen EPOS course curriculum.
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Completed degree; academic degree must have been awarded within the last 6 years.
eligibility_requirements.graduation_year_restrictions: Degree certificate date must not exceed 6 years prior to application deadline.
eligibility_requirements.work_experience_notes: STRICT MANDATORY REQUIREMENT: At least two years of relevant professional experience AFTER completing bachelor's degree at the time of application.
eligibility_requirements.language_notes: IELTS Academic (minimum 6.0 or 6.5 depending on course) or TOEFL iBT (minimum 80). For German-taught courses: DSH 2 or TestDaF 4.
eligibility_requirements.other_language_requirements: Basic German is beneficial; DAAD provides a preparatory German course.
eligibility_requirements.special_eligibility_categories: Applicants must demonstrate strong motivation to assume social responsibility and drive development in their home country.
eligibility_requirements.previous_scholarship_restrictions: Applicants who have been resident in Germany for more than 15 months at the time of application are ineligible.

tuition_fee.details: 100% tuition fees covered (German state universities have no or low tuition; any specialized course tuition is paid by DAAD).

admission_application_fee.details: Handled through direct university application or uni-assist reimbursement voucher.

accommodation.details: Covered via monthly scholarship payment; rent subsidy granted where accommodation costs exceed normal threshold.

monthly_stipend.details: Monthly living stipend paid directly by DAAD.
monthly_stipend.amount: €934 / month for Master's; €1,300 / month for PhD (~PKR 280,000 to 390,000 / month)

airfare.details: Adequate flat-rate travel allowance for flights between Pakistan and Germany upon arrival and departure.

visa_fee.details: German student visa fees waived by the German Embassy in Islamabad / Consulate in Karachi upon presentation of DAAD award letter.

health_insurance.details: Comprehensive health, accident, and personal liability insurance covered directly by DAAD.

food_allowance.details: Included within monthly stipend.

books_and_materials_allowance.details: One-off study grant paid annually (€460/year).

research_funding_conference_grant.details: Field research subsidies and conference attendance grants available for thesis work.

travel_transit_allowance.details: Preparatory German language course (up to 6 months) with all expenses and accommodation covered in Germany prior to master's start.

university_and_program_options.single_or_multiple_universities: Applicants may apply for up to three EPOS courses, prioritizing their order of preference (Rank 1, 2, 3) on the DAAD application form.
participating_institutions: TU Munich, RWTH Aachen, TU Berlin, Univ of Bonn, Freiburg, Stuttgart, Hohenheim, Flensburg, Dresden, Leipzig, Hannover, etc.
university_and_program_options.university_rankings_scope: TU9 German Institutes of Technology and leading research universities.
university_and_program_options.admission_requirements_summary: Bachelor's degree, 2+ years verified work experience certificate, employer recommendation letter, Motivation Letter with developmental focus, DAAD form.
university_and_program_options.easiest_hardest_institutions_guidance: Single application submitted directly to the university coordinator of the respective EPOS master's program (or via DAAD portal depending on course instructions).
university_and_program_options.strategic_program_match_advice: Ensure current employment in Pakistan directly connects to the technical curriculum of the German master's course.

application_process_roadmap.portal_system_name: DAAD Portal & Host University Portals (specified in EPOS brochure)
application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Review EPOS brochure, identify course, apply directly to the university's online admission system, uploading the DAAD application form.
step_by_step_workflow: 1. Download and review the latest DAAD EPOS Course Catalogue brochure.
2. Verify that you have at least 2 years of post-graduation professional work experience.
3. Secure employer support letter and professional reference on official company letterhead.
4. Complete the official DAAD Application Form (available on DAAD website).
5. Write Hand-signed Motivation Letter (max 2 pages) emphasizing developmental relevance to Pakistan.
6. Format CV in Europass format (hand-signed and dated).
7. Submit complete dossier to the host university course coordinator before individual course deadline (typically August - November).
8. University selection committee reviews applications and creates shortlisted ranking.
9. DAAD central committee confirms scholarship awards (January - March).
10. Successful applicants attend 2-6 months German language course (if applicable) starting April/July.
11. Master's program begins in October.
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Integrated routing: Applications are submitted directly to the university running the EPOS course.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Uploaded directly by candidate with hand-signatures, official stamps, and institutional contact details.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Detailed Letter of Motivation (max 2 pages, hand-signed): Academic reasons, professional achievements, why this course in Germany, and how you will apply knowledge in Pakistan.
application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: PhD candidates must submit a detailed research proposal approved by a German university professor.
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: Europass CV (must be hand-signed and dated at the bottom).
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: Generally paper-based evaluation; some individual university committees may conduct short technical Zoom interviews.
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: IELTS Academic or TOEFL iBT. No GRE needed.
application_process_roadmap.application_fee_amount: €0.00 in most cases; nominal fee (€75) if course requires preliminary screening via uni-assist.
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: HEC degree attestation required for German university enrolment and visa processing.
application_process_roadmap.translation_requirements: Certified German or English translation of academic documents.
application_process_roadmap.final_submission_method: Submitted online via university portal or DAAD portal according to course instructions.

important_dates_timeline.application_deadline: August 31 to November 30 annually (each course sets its own deadline)
important_dates_timeline.visa_application_window: May - July (German Embassy student visa appointment)
important_dates_timeline.annual_cycle_notes: Very strict 6-year degree expiration rule and 2-year post-graduation work experience cutoff.

selection_process_and_weights.academic_weight: 25% (Quality of undergraduate degree and grades)
selection_process_and_weights.research_experience_weight: 10% (Academic rigor in undergraduate thesis)
selection_process_and_weights.work_experience_weight: 30% (Substantive 2+ years work experience and employer endorsement)
selection_process_and_weights.personal_statement_weight: 20% (Development-oriented motivation letter)
selection_process_and_weights.selection_panel_composition: Joint committee of German university course professors and DAAD scholarship selection officers.
selection_process_and_weights.evaluation_methodology: Two-phase review: Course director sifts for academic and professional fit; DAAD checks regulatory compliance and awards funding.

competitiveness_profile.total_annual_applicants: ~8,000 to 12,000 applicants globally across all EPOS courses
competitiveness_profile.acceptance_rate_pakistan: ~2.5% to 3.5% (Very Competitive)
competitiveness_profile.typical_academic_and_research_profile: Solid academic foundation combined with 2-5 years of real-world public/private/NGO work in Pakistan.
competitiveness_profile.common_backgrounds_of_winners: Engineers from WAPDA/NESPAK, urban planners, environmental researchers, ministry staff, agricultural scientists, doctors.
competitiveness_profile.high_representation_countries: Pakistan, Vietnam, Colombia, Kenya, Ghana, Indonesia.

fake_websites_and_scams: Commercial visa agents claiming they can bypass the 2-year work experience rule. DAAD checks employment contracts rigorously.
red_flags_and_warnings.application_fee_warning: DAAD never charges application fees.
red_flags_and_warnings.agent_and_intermediary_warnings: DAAD strictly rejects applications prepared by commercial agencies.
hidden_costs_breakdown: IELTS test fee (~PKR 60,000).
German Embassy visa processing and courier fees (~PKR 25,000).
Blocked bank account waiver: DAAD award letter serves as financial guarantee, saving the student from having to deposit €11,208 into a German blocked account!
misleading_claims_debunked: MYTH: Internships during university count towards the 2-year work experience rule. (Fact: DAAD strictly counts work experience acquired AFTER completion of the bachelor's degree).
MYTH: You cannot work in Germany after graduation. (Fact: Germany allows 18-month Job Seeker Visa for all German university graduates; EPOS scholars can utilize this or return to Pakistan).
official_vs_unofficial_discrepancies: Third-party sites frequently give a single generic DAAD deadline; each EPOS course has its own unique deadline between August and November.

scholarship_obligations_and_terms.minimum_gpa_maintenance: Must pass all exams and semester coursework according to German university study regulations.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.attendance_requirements: Full-time study attendance in Germany.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.academic_progress_monitoring: Annual progress and transcript checks submitted to DAAD.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.work_restrictions_during_study: Part-time work permitted up to 120 full days or 240 half days per year under German student visa, but any secondary income above €520/month is deducted from the DAAD stipend.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.home_country_return_obligation: Scholars are strongly expected to return to Pakistan upon graduation to contribute to national development, though no formal financial bond is enforced.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.service_obligations_or_bonds: Agreement with employer in Pakistan if study leave was granted.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.repayment_clawback_conditions: Termination of grant and clawback of funds in cases of academic fraud, unapproved withdrawal, or disciplinary dismissal.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_university: Strictly disallowed; grant is tied to the specific EPOS course.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_major: Strictly prohibited.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.extension_policy: Extensions are granted only in rare cases of certified illness or unforeseen laboratory delays.

application_process_roadmap.submission_portal_url: https://www.edisu.piemonte.it/ (and respective regional portals: dsu.toscana.it, er-go.it, laziodisco.it)

application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Register on the respective regional scholarship portal (opens June/July) using passport details, and submit Universitaly pre-enrolment application.
step_by_step_workflow: 1. Apply to Italian university during admission calls (December - April) and secure admission letter.
2. Submit pre-enrolment application on official Universitaly portal (universitaly.it).

3. Gather family financial documents in Pakistan: Family Registration Certificate (FRC), Income Certificate (FBR return or employer letter), Property/House documents (Tehsildar certificate), Bank statements.
4. Attest all financial documents from MOFA (Ministry of Foreign Affairs) in Pakistan.
5. Translate all documents into Italian via official Italian Embassy approved translators.
6. Obtain Consular Legalization / Declaration of Value (DOV) or CIMEA comparability certificate.
7. Send documents to Italian Tax Assistance Center (CAF) in Italy to calculate ISEE Parificato certificate.
8. Apply online on the regional scholarship portal (e.g. EDISU / DSU) before late August / early September deadline.
9. Provisional ranking list published (September/October); Final ranking in December.
10. 1st stipend installment and free meal card issued in December/January; 2nd installment in June.

Italian Embassy student visa appointment and Gerry's fees (~PKR 25,000).

CRITICAL INITIAL CASH BUFFER: The first DSU scholarship installment is paid in late December or January. Students MUST arrive in Italy with sufficient personal funds (€1,500 to €2,500) to cover initial rent deposits and food for the first 3 months!
Italian Permesso di Soggiorno (Residence Permit) card fee (€120) upon arrival.
misleading_claims_debunked: MYTH: You get paid before traveling. (Fact: You do NOT receive any money before arriving in Italy; the scholarship is disbursed only after physical university matriculation in Italy).

eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Students in final year of bachelor's degree can apply if they graduate before program matriculation (August/September).

tuition_fee.details: 100% participation costs and university tuition fees covered across all partner universities in the consortium.

health_insurance.details: Full comprehensive international health, travel, and accident insurance meeting European Commission standards for the full 24 months.

food_allowance.details: Included within the €1,400/month stipend.

books_and_materials_allowance.details: Access to laboratory, library, and consortium resources included in participation cost waiver.

research_funding_conference_grant.details: Consortium travel grants available for attending European conferences and thesis research placement.

travel_transit_allowance.details: Embedded in the monthly scholarship rate (€1,400/month flat rate covers all mobility between countries).

application_process_roadmap.portal_system_name: Individual Consortium Portals (listed on EACEA Catalogue)
application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Explore EACEA Catalogue, identify up to 3 programs, and register on each consortium's dedicated application portal.
step_by_step_workflow: 1. Search the EACEA Erasmus Mundus Catalogue for programs matching your discipline.
2. Visit the chosen program website (e.g. Master in Big Data, Marine Biotechnology, etc.).
3. Register on the specific consortium portal (opens October - November).
4. Upload Bachelor's degree, transcripts, and proof of residence.
5. Write tailored Motivation Letter explaining why this specific multi-country curriculum fits your goals.
6. Format CV in Europass format.
7. Add details of 2 academic referees who upload letters directly.
8. Submit online application before January/February deadline.
9. Consortium selection board evaluates files (February - March).
10. Results announced (March - April); Main list (scholarship winners) and Reserve list notified.
11. Consortia provide visa guarantee letters for Country 1 visa application (May - July).
12. Arrive in Country 1 for orientation (September).

nationality_requirements: Citizens of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan
eligibility_requirements.age_limit_notes: PhD applicants: Born after December 31, 1989 (under 35 years of age). Postdoctoral applicants: PhD completed within the last 5 years.
eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: Master's degree (18 years education / MS / MPhil) achieved before July 31 preceding start of scholarship with exceptional academic distinction.
eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: Minimum 3.50/4.00 CGPA or top 10% class standing; competitive applicants typically hold published research papers.
eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: Master's degree directly in the subject area of the proposed doctoral research.
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Master's completed or in final semester (degree must be formally awarded before departure).
eligibility_requirements.graduation_year_restrictions: Postdoc applicants must have obtained PhD within the prior 5 years.
eligibility_requirements.work_experience_notes: Not mandatory; solid academic research record is paramount.
eligibility_requirements.language_notes: Language certificate in the language of instruction (English, German, or French) as required by the host professor/university.
eligibility_requirements.other_language_requirements: German, French, or Italian proficiency is required if research is conducted in that language; most STEM labs at ETH/EPFL operate 100% in English.
eligibility_requirements.special_eligibility_categories: ABSOLUTE PREREQUISITE: Must have secured a formal written letter of acceptance from a tenured professor at a Swiss university agreeing to supervise the candidate before applying to the Embassy.
eligibility_requirements.previous_scholarship_restrictions: Applicants who have previously received a Swiss Government Excellence Scholarship are ineligible.

tuition_fee.details: Full tuition and bench fee exemption at Swiss universities under federal decree.

admission_application_fee.details: Covered under federal scholarship status.

accommodation.details: Covered via monthly stipend; FCS provides assistance in securing student housing.

monthly_stipend.details: Tax-free monthly living allowance paid directly to the scholar.
monthly_stipend.amount: CHF 1,920 / month for PhD (~PKR 620,000 / month); CHF 3,500 / month for Postdoc (~PKR 1,120,000 / month)

airfare.details: Flight to Switzerland at the start is NOT covered (borne by scholar); however, FCS provides a return flight allowance back to Pakistan upon degree completion.

visa_fee.details: Swiss national visa (Type D) application fee is waived by the Embassy of Switzerland in Islamabad.

health_insurance.details: Mandatory Swiss health and accident insurance (Krankenversicherung) fully paid directly by FCS throughout the stay.

food_allowance.details: Covered via monthly stipend.

books_and_materials_allowance.details: Covered via host university laboratory facilities.

research_funding_conference_grant.details: Funded through Swiss National Science Foundation (SNSF) laboratory grants.

university_and_program_options.strategic_program_match_advice: Start contacting professors at ETH, EPFL, or Uni Zurich in June/July with a customized research pitch demonstrating familiarity with their recent papers.

application_process_roadmap.portal_system_name: Embassy of Switzerland in Islamabad (Physical Submission) & SERI Federal Portal
application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Request the official application package by emailing the Embassy of Switzerland in Islamabad in early August; submit complete physical dossier in triplicate.
step_by_step_workflow: 1. Contact a professor at a Swiss public university and obtain an official Letter of Acceptance and professor CV (June - August).
2. Email Embassy of Switzerland in Islamabad to request official FCS application package (August).
3. Write 5-page Research Proposal using the official FCS template.
4. Complete official FCS Application Form and obtain 2 confidential letters of recommendation from professors on FCS forms.
5. Complete medical certificate of health.
6. Submit complete physical dossier (1 original + 2 copies) to the Embassy of Switzerland in Islamabad before late September deadline.
7. Embassy conducts preliminary document review and forwards files to Bern.
8. Federal Commission for Scholarships for Foreign Students (FCS) evaluates files in Switzerland (December - April).
9. Final selection results announced by the Swiss Embassy in May.
10. Apply for Swiss National D Visa in Islamabad (June/July).
11. Arrive in Switzerland (September).
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Professor Acceptance First -> Embassy Application -> FCS Central Selection.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Submitted using official FCS confidential recommendation forms signed and sealed in envelopes.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Motivation Letter (max 2 pages): Academic background, why Switzerland, reasons for selecting this specific research group, and future career impact.
application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: Strict 5-page Research Proposal: Background, research questions, methodology, timetable, and societal significance.
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: Europass format with full list of publications and conference presentations.
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: Strictly dossier-based evaluation; no interview conducted by Embassy.
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: No GRE required; English certificate required by host university.
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: Attestation of degree certificates by HEC and MOFA.
application_process_roadmap.translation_requirements: Certified English, German, or French translations.
application_process_roadmap.final_submission_method: Physical delivery of 3 complete sets of hardcopy documents to the Embassy of Switzerland in Islamabad.

nationality_requirements: Citizen of a Chevening-eligible country or territory (Pakistan is fully eligible)
eligibility_requirements.age_limit_notes: No upper age limit. Applicants range from recent graduates (with work hours) to senior mid-career leaders.
eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: Undergraduate degree that enables entry onto a postgraduate programme at a UK university (equivalent to an upper second-class 2:1 honours degree in the UK; typically 16 years education in Pakistan).
eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: Equivalent to UK 2:1 honours; for Pakistan, 3.0/4.0 CGPA or 65%+ marks in semester system.
eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: Any academic field; high-impact fields aligned with UK-Pakistan development priorities (governance, public health, climate, education, human rights, technology) receive strong interest.
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Completed undergraduate degree by the time of Chevening application submission in November.
eligibility_requirements.work_experience_notes: Mandatory minimum of 2 years work experience (strictly calculated as at least 2,800 hours). Eligible experience includes full-time, part-time, voluntary work, and paid/unpaid internships.
eligibility_requirements.language_notes: Chevening removed its central English language requirement in 2020. However, applicants must meet the individual English language requirements of their chosen UK universities (typically IELTS 6.5-7.0 or university waiver).
eligibility_requirements.other_language_requirements: None.
eligibility_requirements.special_eligibility_categories: British citizens or dual British nationals are ineligible. Employees or former employees of His Majesty's Government (or relatives) within the past 2 years are ineligible.
eligibility_requirements.previous_scholarship_restrictions: Applicants who have previously studied in the UK with funding from a UK government-funded scholarship are ineligible.

tuition_fee.details: Full university tuition fees paid directly to the university. Note: MBA programs have a fee cap of £22,000 (applicant must pay remainder).

admission_application_fee.details: UK university application fees (e.g. Oxford/Cambridge application fees £75-£85) are paid by applicant unless university waives them.

accommodation.details: Provided within the monthly living allowance; students arrange private or university accommodation.

monthly_stipend.details: Tax-free monthly living stipend.
monthly_stipend.amount: £1,347 / month outside London; £1,652 / month inside London (~PKR 490,000 to 600,000)

airfare.details: Economy class return flights from Pakistan to the UK booked directly via Chevening travel partner (Diversity Travel).

visa_fee.details: The cost of one Student Route visa application fee is reimbursed.

health_insurance.details: Immigration Health Surcharge (IHS) is covered/exempt for Chevening scholars, giving access to the UK National Health Service (NHS).

food_allowance.details: Included within the monthly living stipend.

books_and_materials_allowance.details: Expected to be covered from the living stipend.

research_funding_conference_grant.details: Chevening covers taught master's courses; dissertation research grants depend on host university departments.

travel_transit_allowance.details: Arrival allowance (£710–£850) upon initial landing and departure allowance upon returning home.

university_and_program_options.single_or_multiple_universities: Must apply to three different eligible UK university courses (either at 3 different universities or 2 different universities).
participating_institutions: All accredited UK universities (Oxford, Cambridge, LSE, Imperial, King's College London, Edinburgh, Manchester, Warwick, Bristol, Leeds, etc.)
university_and_program_options.university_rankings_scope: UK Top 1 to Top 50 universities.
university_and_program_options.admission_requirements_summary: Undergraduate degree transcripts, references, personal statement, and fulfillment of university-specific entry criteria.
university_and_program_options.easiest_hardest_institutions_guidance: Applicants do NOT need offers when applying in November. However, having 1 reach school (e.g. Oxford/LSE) and 2 strong match schools (e.g. Sheffield, Sussex, Leeds) prevents being stranded without an unconditional offer by July.
university_and_program_options.strategic_program_match_advice: Ensure the three selected courses share an interconnected academic theme so your Chevening essays effectively justify all three choices.

application_process_roadmap.portal_system_name: Chevening Online Application System (OAS)
application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Register on Chevening OAS in August using primary email address; select Pakistan as application country.
step_by_step_workflow: 1. Register on Chevening OAS (opens early August).
2. Complete eligibility pre-screening questionnaire.
3. Write 4 mandatory 500-word essays: Leadership & Influence, Networking, Study in the UK, Career Plan.
4. Select 3 eligible UK master's courses.
5. Submit online application before early November deadline.
6. Independent reading committee sifts applications (November - January).
7. Shortlisted candidates invited for interview (mid-February).
8. Upload 2 reference letters and education documents to OAS (February - March).
9. Attend in-person panel interview at British High Commission Islamabad or Deputy High Commission Karachi (March - May).
10. Conditional selection results announced in June.
11. Secure at least one unconditional university offer and submit by mid-July deadline.
12. Final award letter issued, Student visa processed, pre-departure briefing (August).
13. Depart to UK (September).
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Completely separate: Apply for Chevening via OAS; apply to the 3 UK universities directly through their respective university admissions portals.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Uploaded directly by candidate or referee to the Chevening OAS upon invitation to interview in February.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Four distinct essays (max 500 words each): 1) Leadership and Influence, 2) Relationship Building and Networking, 3) Studying in the UK (justifying course choices), 4) Career Plan (immediate, 5-year, and 10-year goals in Pakistan).
application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: Not applicable (taught degree); covered under Essay 3 explaining how selected courses bridge applicant's skill gaps.
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: Standard professional CV detailing chronological employment hours.
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: Strict 30-40 minute in-person panel interview at British High Commission Islamabad/Karachi conducted entirely in English with British diplomats and Chevening alumni.
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: No standardized tests required by Chevening; IELTS/TOEFL required by individual UK universities.
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: HEC degree attestation required by UK universities for unconditional offers.
application_process_roadmap.translation_requirements: Certified English translations of all academic transcripts.
application_process_roadmap.final_submission_method: 100% online portal submission (OAS).

scholarship_obligations_and_terms.academic_progress_monitoring: Host universities submit regular engagement and grade reports to the Chevening Secretariat.

scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_university: Once an award is confirmed in July, changing universities or courses is strictly prohibited except under exceptional university course cancellation.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_major: Strictly prohibited.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.extension_policy: Scholarship extensions beyond the 12-month grant period are strictly impossible under FCDO policy.

basic_details.major_restrictions: Must align with one of six Commonwealth Development Themes: 1) Science and tech for development, 2) Health systems, 3) Global prosperity, 4) Peace and governance, 5) Resilience and crisis response, 6) Access and inclusion.
basic_details.number_of_awards_total: ~800 scholars and fellows funded globally each year
basic_details.number_of_awards_pakistan: ~25 to 40 awards for Pakistan annually via national nominating agencies
basic_details.duration_of_scholarship: 12 months for Master's; up to 36 months for PhD

nationality_requirements: Citizen of or refugee in an eligible Commonwealth country (Pakistan is eligible)
eligibility_requirements.age_limit_notes: No upper age limit.
eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: Minimum upper second-class (2:1) first degree (16 years education for Master's); relevant Master's (18 years education) for PhD.
eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: Minimum 2:1 honours equivalent; HEC criteria typically require minimum 65% or 3.0/4.0 CGPA.
eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: Course aligned with one of the 6 CSC development themes.
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Degree completed by start of UK academic year.
eligibility_requirements.work_experience_notes: Work experience is not mandatory, but professional experience in development or research is heavily valued.
eligibility_requirements.language_notes: CSC does not require an English test directly; applicants must meet the individual English language conditions of their selected UK universities.
eligibility_requirements.other_language_requirements: None.
eligibility_requirements.special_eligibility_categories: Candidates must sign a declaration confirming they could NOT afford to study in the UK without this scholarship.
eligibility_requirements.previous_scholarship_restrictions: Cannot have previously studied for 1+ academic years in a high-income country.

tuition_fee.details: Full approved university tuition fees covered under CSC agreement.

admission_application_fee.details: University application fees paid by applicant.

accommodation.details: Provided within the monthly living stipend.

monthly_stipend.details: Monthly living stipend paid directly by CSC.
monthly_stipend.amount: £1,347 / month outside London; £1,652 / month inside London (~PKR 490,000 to 600,000)

airfare.details: Approved economy class air travel from Pakistan to the UK and return flight upon completion.

visa_fee.details: UK Student Route visa application fee reimbursed.

health_insurance.details: Access to NHS covered; immigration health surcharge handled via CSC exemption.

food_allowance.details: Included in monthly living allowance.

books_and_materials_allowance.details: Study travel grant towards the cost of study-related travel in the UK or overseas.

research_funding_conference_grant.details: Fieldwork travel grant for PhD candidates to return to Pakistan for data collection.

travel_transit_allowance.details: Warm clothing allowance (£500–£550) upon initial arrival in the UK.

university_and_program_options.single_or_multiple_universities: Applicants may list up to 3 UK university course choices on their CSC application form.
participating_institutions: UK Universities having part-funding agreements with CSC (Cambridge, Oxford, Imperial, Edinburgh, Manchester, Birmingham, Glasgow, Leeds, Sussex, etc.)
university_and_program_options.university_rankings_scope: UK top-ranked universities.
university_and_program_options.program_duration: 12 months for Master's; 36 months for PhD
university_and_program_options.admission_requirements_summary: Undergraduate degree, personal statement, development impact plan, references.
university_and_program_options.easiest_hardest_institutions_guidance: Applicants do not need university admission at initial nomination, but must secure university offers before CSC final confirmation.
university_and_program_options.strategic_program_match_advice: Explicitly align your course and proposal with the UN Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) and Pakistani National Priorities.

application_process_roadmap.portal_system_name: CSC Online Application System (OAS) & HEC Pakistan Portal
application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Dual submission process: Apply on CSC OAS portal AND on HEC Pakistan scholarship portal.
step_by_step_workflow: 1. Apply via CSC OAS (opens September).
2. Apply via HEC Pakistan portal (scholarship.hec.gov.pk) under Commonwealth nominating category.
3. Take HEC HAT test (Higher Education Aptitude Test) organized by ETC Pakistan.
4. Upload Development Impact statements addressing local and national impact.
5. Two reference letters uploaded directly by referees to CSC OAS.
6. Submit both applications before respective deadlines (mid-October for CSC; October for HEC).
7. HEC screens applicants based on HAT scores and academic merit to create national nomination list.
8. Nominated candidates' applications sent to CSC UK for final central selection review.
9. CSC announces final awards in May/June.
10. Finalists secure unconditional university offers, obtain visas, and depart in September.
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Dual routing: Nominated via HEC Pakistan to CSC UK; apply separately to UK universities.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Submitted online by referees directly via CSC OAS.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Detailed Development Impact Statement in 4 parts: 1) Impact on development within 2 years, 2) Impact in 5-10 years, 3) How impact will be measured, 4) Relevance to national development priorities in Pakistan.
application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: Comprehensive research proposal required for PhD applicants including methodology, ethics, and developmental significance.
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: Complete employment and education history in CSC OAS format.
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: CSC UK does not conduct interviews for general Master's/PhD; selection is 100% paper and dossier evaluation. HEC may conduct interviews for specific nominations.
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: HEC HAT test required in Pakistan for national shortlisting.
application_process_roadmap.application_fee_amount: £0.00 / PKR 0 to CSC (HEC charges nominal HAT test fee ~PKR 2,000).
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: HEC attestation of degrees required prior to departure.
application_process_roadmap.translation_requirements: Certified English translations.
application_process_roadmap.final_submission_method: Dual online portal submission (CSC OAS + HEC Portal).

required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Required to prove citizenship and residency

required_documents_checklist.specification: Complete university transcripts with grading key
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Must be recognized by HEC Pakistan

required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Must be provided via online portal

required_documents_checklist.specification: Exhaustive 4-part plan linking study to Pakistani socioeconomic growth
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Crucial scoring factor for CSC panel

required_documents_checklist.specification: Valid Higher Education Aptitude Test result
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Mandatory for HEC Pakistan nomination shortlist

important_dates_timeline.shortlist_announcement: HEC nominations announced December; CSC final results announced May/June
important_dates_timeline.annual_cycle_notes: Being nominated by HEC does NOT guarantee the scholarship; CSC UK makes final selections based on global development scoring.

selection_process_and_weights.academic_weight: 33% (Academic merit of the candidate)
selection_process_and_weights.research_experience_weight: 15% (Quality of study plan / research proposal)
selection_process_and_weights.personal_statement_weight: 25% (Potential impact on the development of the home country)
selection_process_and_weights.test_scores_weight: Screening filter via HEC HAT in Pakistan
selection_process_and_weights.financial_need_weight: Gatekeeper requirement (declaration of inability to self-fund)
selection_process_and_weights.selection_panel_composition: Independent panels of senior UK academic subject specialists appointed by CSC.
selection_process_and_weights.evaluation_methodology: Scoring across 3 core criteria: 1) Academic merit, 2) Quality of study plan, 3) Potential development impact on the home country.

competitiveness_profile.total_annual_applicants: ~15,000 to 20,000 applicants globally; ~2,000 in Pakistan
competitiveness_profile.acceptance_rate_pakistan: ~1.5% (Highly Competitive)
competitiveness_profile.typical_academic_and_research_profile: Solid academic foundation with strong focus on poverty reduction, public health, climate, or sustainable industrialization.
competitiveness_profile.common_backgrounds_of_winners: Public sector researchers, university lecturers, civil servants, NGO workers, and environmental scientists.
competitiveness_profile.high_representation_countries: Pakistan, Nigeria, Kenya, Bangladesh, India.

red_flags_and_warnings.application_fee_warning: CSC charges NO application fee whatsoever.
red_flags_and_warnings.agent_and_intermediary_warnings: CSC applications must be submitted solely by the candidate.
hidden_costs_breakdown: HEC HAT test registration fee (PKR 2,000).
IELTS/English test fees required by UK universities.
Tuberculosis screening certificate fee (IOM clinics PKR 15,000 to 20,000).
misleading_claims_debunked: MYTH: An HEC nomination guarantees a scholarship. (Fact: HEC nominates ~2x the quota; CSC UK rejects around 50% of national nominees during the final central review).
official_vs_unofficial_discrepancies: Some third parties claim work experience is mandatory; official CSC rules do not require work experience for Master's courses.

scholarship_obligations_and_terms.attendance_requirements: Full-time physical attendance in the UK.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.academic_progress_monitoring: Annual progress reports submitted by university supervisors to CSC.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.work_restrictions_during_study: Part-time employment allowed up to 20 hours/week under UK visa rules, subject to academic supervisor approval.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.home_country_return_obligation: MANDATORY Return: Must return to home country upon completion of the award. Ineligible for UK graduate work route visas.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.service_obligations_or_bonds: Agreement to return and apply skills to home country development.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.repayment_clawback_conditions: Failure to complete degree or failure to return to home country triggers repayment obligation.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_university: Changing institutions is not allowed without express prior permission from CSC.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_major: Strictly prohibited.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.extension_policy: Extensions are rarely granted; PhD funding capped strictly at 36 months.

name: Eiffel Excellence Scholarship Programme (Campus France)
host_institution: French Higher Education Institutions (Sorbonne, École Polytechnique, PSL, CentraleSupélec)

funding.tuition: French Public Universities have heavily subsidized fees (~EUR 243-380/yr)
funding.accommodation: Assisted housing in CROUS student residences
funding.monthly_stipend: EUR 1,181 / month for Master's, EUR 1,700 / month for PhD
funding.travel_airfare: COVERED (International round-trip flights from Pakistan to France)
funding.health_insurance: French Social Security (Sécurité Sociale) + supplementary mutuelle
funding.settlement_allowance: Local transport ticket allowance and cultural activities

language.notes: Many engineering and AI master's programs in France are 100% taught in English.

description: France's top merit award by the Ministry for Europe and Foreign Affairs. Application is submitted by the French university on student's behalf.

basic_details.scholarship_name: Eiffel Excellence Scholarship Programme
basic_details.offering_entity: French Ministry for Europe and Foreign Affairs (MEAE) & Campus France
basic_details.host_institutions_covered: All accredited French Universities and Grandes Écoles (Sorbonne, École Polytechnique, PSL, Paris-Saclay, Sciences Po, CentraleSupélec, INSA)
basic_details.major_restrictions: Seven priority study fields: Science and Technology (Biology and Health, Ecological Transition, Mathematics and Digital, Engineering Sciences), and Humanities and Social Sciences (French History, Language and Civilization, Law and Political Science, Economics and Management).
basic_details.number_of_awards_total: ~350 to 400 scholarships awarded annually across 100+ countries
basic_details.number_of_awards_pakistan: Open to Pakistan; numerous Pakistani scholars selected annually for French Grandes Écoles and research universities
basic_details.duration_of_scholarship: Master's: 12 to 36 months depending on entry level (M1 or M2); PhD: up to 36 months (or 6-18 months for joint-supervision cotutelle)

nationality_requirements: Non-French nationality (Pakistani citizens eligible; dual French citizens strictly ineligible)
eligibility_requirements.age_limit_notes: Master's candidates: maximum 27 years of age at the time of application; PhD candidates: maximum 32 years of age.
eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: 16 years of education (Bachelor's) for Master's; 18 years (Master's with research thesis) for PhD from an HEC-recognized institution.
eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: Minimum 3.30 / 4.00 CGPA or equivalent; admitted candidates typically rank in the top 5% of their graduating class.
eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: Academic background aligned with one of the 7 designated priority areas.
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Graduated or in final semester of degree in home country.
eligibility_requirements.graduation_year_restrictions: None, provided age criteria are respected.
eligibility_requirements.work_experience_notes: Academic excellence, scientific publications, and international outlook prioritized.

english_proficiency.notes: Language requirement depends on the chosen program; English-taught programs require IELTS 6.5+ or TOEFL 90+; French-taught programs require DELF/DALF B2/C1.

eligibility_requirements.other_language_requirements: French not mandatory for programs taught 100% in English.
eligibility_requirements.special_eligibility_categories: Candidates CANNOT apply directly; they MUST be selected and nominated by a French higher education institution.
eligibility_requirements.previous_scholarship_restrictions: Must not have previously received an Eiffel scholarship at the same degree level, or another French government scholarship.

tuition_fee.details: Eiffel does NOT pay tuition fees; however, nominating French public universities waive international tuition fees for Eiffel recipients; Grandes Écoles often waive or subsidize remaining fees.

admission_application_fee.details: Managed directly by nominating French institution.

accommodation.details: Campus France reserves public student housing (CROUS) for Eiffel scholars; rent is paid from monthly living allowance.

monthly_stipend.details: Generous monthly maintenance allowance paid directly to student.
monthly_stipend.amount: Master's: €1,181 / month (~PKR 355,000 / month); PhD: €1,800 / month (~PKR 540,000 / month)

airfare.details: Single round-trip international economy class flight between home country and France.

visa_fee.details: French student visa application fee waived by the French Embassy for Eiffel scholars.

health_insurance.details: Campus France provides private health insurance until enrollment in the free French National Health Insurance (Sécurité Sociale).

food_allowance.details: Covered from monthly living allowance.

books_and_materials_allowance.details: Covered from monthly living allowance.

research_funding_conference_grant.details: Cultural activities, excursions, and travel within France organized and funded by Campus France.

travel_transit_allowance.details: Domestic train travel from Paris airport to host university city fully covered.

university_and_program_options.single_or_multiple_universities: Single French higher education institution (University or Grande École).
university_and_program_options.university_rankings_scope: Premier French research universities and elite Grandes Écoles.
available_majors: Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Computer Science, Mathematics, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Biotechnology, Health Sciences, Renewable Energy, Environmental Sciences, Economics, Management, Law, Political Science
university_and_program_options.program_duration: Master's: 1 to 2 years; PhD: up to 3 years
university_and_program_options.admission_requirements_summary: Must apply to a French institution; the institution selects top candidates and submits the Eiffel dossier on their behalf to Campus France.
university_and_program_options.easiest_hardest_institutions_guidance: French institutions have internal pre-selection deadlines (typically October-November); early contact is essential.
university_and_program_options.strategic_program_match_advice: Focus on high-ranking English-taught Master's degrees at Paris-Saclay, Sorbonne, or Institut Polytechnique de Paris.

application_process_roadmap.portal_system_name: Campus France Eiffel Online Institutional Platform
application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Candidates cannot submit applications directly. You must contact the international relations office or program director of your chosen French university.
step_by_step_workflow: 1. Identify eligible master's or PhD programs at French universities/Grandes Écoles (September-October).
2. Contact the French university's international relations office expressing interest in Eiffel nomination.
3. Submit required application materials to the French institution before their internal deadline (usually November).
4. If accepted and selected, the French institution completes and submits the official Eiffel application to Campus France by early January.
5. Campus France scientific committees evaluate institutional dossiers in February/March.
6. Results published on the Campus France website in early April.
7. Selected scholars contact Campus France to arrange airfare and visa formalities.
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Institutional nomination: Candidate applies to French university; university submits Eiffel dossier to Campus France.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Submitted to the nominating French institution.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Demonstrate academic excellence, international career objectives, and justification for choosing France.
application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: PhD candidates must submit a 1 to 5-page research project endorsed by the French thesis director.
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: Curriculum Vitae (in French or English) emphasizing academic honors, rank in class, and publications (1-2 pages).
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: French university admissions teams conduct video interviews prior to nominating candidates for Eiffel.
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: English test (IELTS/TOEFL) for English programs, or French test (DELF/DALF) for French programs.
application_process_roadmap.application_fee_amount: $0 for Eiffel; some Grandes Écoles may have application fees.
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: Certified copies of degree certificates and transcripts; HEC attestation required.
application_process_roadmap.translation_requirements: Official certified translations into French or English.
application_process_roadmap.final_submission_method: Submitted online by the nominating French institution via the Campus France portal.

required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Submitted directly by the French university to Campus France

required_documents_checklist.specification: Transcripts showing all grades, GPA, and official certificate of class rank
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Attested by HEC Pakistan; rank in class is crucial for Eiffel selection

required_documents_checklist.specification: 1-2 page CV in English or French
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Highlighting academic awards, research projects, and publications

required_documents_checklist.specification: Personal statement explaining career vision and reasons for studying in France
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Clear narrative on how French expertise will impact career

required_documents_checklist.specification: IELTS Academic (6.5+) or TOEFL iBT (90+) for English programs
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Valid test certificate

important_dates_timeline.annual_cycle_notes: French universities' internal deadlines are between late October and late November. Final Campus France submission deadline is early January; results released in early April.

selection_process_and_weights.academic_weight: 40% (Academic excellence, class ranking, reputation of home university)
selection_process_and_weights.research_experience_weight: 25% (Research output, thesis proposal for PhD)
selection_process_and_weights.personal_statement_weight: 10% (Clarity and feasibility of professional project)
selection_process_and_weights.recommendations_weight: 10% (Quality of French institution's endorsement and international strategy)
selection_process_and_weights.selection_panel_composition: Campus France scientific expert committees composed of leading French university professors and researchers.
selection_process_and_weights.evaluation_methodology: Three criteria: Candidate excellence (40%), Institutional international policy (30%), MEAE geographical priority balance (30%).

competitiveness_profile.total_annual_applicants: ~1,500 institutional nominations submitted by French universities (from thousands of applicants)
competitiveness_profile.acceptance_rate_global: ~25% of institutionally nominated candidates (~2% to 3% of total applicants)
competitiveness_profile.acceptance_rate_pakistan: ~2% to 3% (Highly Selective)
competitiveness_profile.typical_academic_and_research_profile: Top students from prestigious Pakistani universities with strong foundational training, international publications, and clear career plans.
competitiveness_profile.common_backgrounds_of_winners: Graduates of NUST, LUMS, GIKI, FAST, Quaid-i-Azam University who secured admission to top French institutions.
competitiveness_profile.high_representation_countries: Global distribution across Asia, Latin America, Middle East, Africa, Eastern Europe.

fake_websites_and_scams: Websites claiming to accept direct Eiffel applications from students; direct applications are automatically disqualified.
red_flags_and_warnings.application_fee_warning: Campus France does NOT charge any fee for the Eiffel scholarship.
red_flags_and_warnings.agent_and_intermediary_warnings: Never use agents; applications MUST be submitted by the French university itself.
hidden_costs_breakdown: CVEC student life and campus contribution fee (~€100, though Eiffel scholars are exempt, initial paperwork required).
Grandes Écoles tuition fee difference if not fully waived by the school.
Initial pocket money before first monthly stipend transfer in France.
misleading_claims_debunked: MYTH: You can submit the application directly to Campus France. (Fact: Applications must be submitted exclusively by a French higher education institution).
MYTH: You must speak fluent French. (Fact: Hundreds of eligible programs are taught 100% in English).
official_vs_unofficial_discrepancies: Many blogs claim Eiffel covers full tuition fees; officially, Eiffel does NOT pay tuition fees; it relies on university tuition waivers.

scholarship_obligations_and_terms.minimum_gpa_maintenance: Must pass all courses and obtain the degree within the normal period (60 ECTS credits per year).
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.attendance_requirements: Full-time physical attendance at host French institution.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.academic_progress_monitoring: Host institutions report academic results annually to Campus France.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.work_restrictions_during_study: Permitted to work up to 60% of annual legal work time (approx 964 hours/year) under French student visa regulations.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.home_country_return_obligation: None; scholars are eligible for the French Job Seeker / Business Creation Residence Permit (RECE) for 1 year post-graduation.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.repayment_clawback_conditions: Failing courses or abandoning studies leads to immediate scholarship termination.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_university: Strictly prohibited; the scholarship is awarded to the specific institution that nominated the student.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_major: Strictly prohibited.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.extension_policy: No extensions granted beyond the initial grant duration.

name: Swedish Institute Scholarships for Global Professionals (SISGP)
host_institution: Swedish Universities (KTH Royal Institute, Chalmers, Lund, Uppsala)

funding.tuition: 100% Full Tuition Fees Paid Directly to Swedish University
funding.accommodation: Covered via monthly stipend
funding.health_insurance: Comprehensive health & accident insurance through Swedish Legal, Financial and Administrative Services Agency
funding.settlement_allowance: Membership in SI Network for Global Professionals

language.notes: University Admissions Sweden requires English 6 level (IELTS 6.5 with no band under 5.5).

description: Sweden's prestigious fully funded master's scholarship for global changemakers with verified work/leadership experience.

basic_details.scholarship_name: Swedish Institute Scholarships for Global Professionals (SISGP)
basic_details.offering_entity: Swedish Institute (SI) & Government of Sweden (Ministry for Foreign Affairs)
basic_details.host_institutions_covered: All Swedish Universities participating in national admissions (KTH Royal Institute of Technology, Chalmers, Lund, Uppsala, Stockholm University, Karolinska Institutet, Gothenburg, Linköping)
basic_details.major_restrictions: Open to ~700 eligible English-taught Master's degree programs aligned with the UN 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development (Sustainability, Climate, Engineering, CS, Public Health, Human Rights, Business).
basic_details.number_of_awards_total: ~350 scholarships awarded annually across 41 eligible countries
basic_details.number_of_awards_pakistan: Open to Pakistan as an eligible partner country (~15 to 25 Pakistani scholars selected annually)
basic_details.duration_of_scholarship: 1 to 2 academic years (full duration of the Master's program: 60 or 120 ECTS credits)

nationality_requirements: Citizen of an eligible country (including Pakistan)
eligibility_requirements.age_limit_notes: No upper age limit.
eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: Completed 16 years of education (4-year Bachelor's degree or 2-year Bachelor's + 2-year Master's) satisfying Swedish university entrance requirements.
eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: Minimum 3.00 / 4.00 CGPA; must meet specific academic prerequisites for chosen Swedish Master's program.
eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: Eligible Master's program in an approved subject area aligned with sustainable development.
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Graduated and currently employed or having substantial past employment.
eligibility_requirements.work_experience_notes: MANDATORY: Minimum 3,000 hours of documented work experience (equivalent to approximately 1.5 to 2 years full-time) prior to the deadline, plus demonstrated leadership experience.

english_proficiency.notes: Must meet Swedish University Admissions English 6 requirement: IELTS Academic 6.5 (no band below 5.5) or TOEFL iBT 90 (writing 20).

eligibility_requirements.other_language_requirements: None; programs taught 100% in English.
eligibility_requirements.special_eligibility_categories: Demonstrated leadership experience, commitment to UN Sustainable Development Goals, and potential to contribute to positive development in Pakistan.
eligibility_requirements.previous_scholarship_restrictions: Ineligible if previously awarded an SI scholarship for master's study, or if currently holding a degree from a Swedish university.

tuition_fee.details: 100% full international tuition fee paid directly by the Swedish Institute to the host Swedish university.

admission_application_fee.details: University Admissions Sweden application fee (SEK 900, ~PKR 25,000) paid by applicant.

accommodation.details: Covered via monthly living allowance.

monthly_stipend.details: Regular monthly living allowance paid throughout the study period.
monthly_stipend.amount: SEK 12,000 / month (~PKR 330,000 / month or SEK 144,000 / year)

airfare.details: One-time travel grant paid upon arrival in Sweden.

visa_fee.details: Swedish residence permit application fee (SEK 1,500) paid by student.

health_insurance.details: Comprehensive health and accident insurance (Kammarkollegiet) provided by the Swedish state.

food_allowance.details: Covered via monthly living stipend.

books_and_materials_allowance.details: Covered from living stipend.

research_funding_conference_grant.details: Full membership in the SI Network for Future Global Professionals (NFGP) and SI Alumni Network with funded workshops.

travel_transit_allowance.details: Included in travel grant.

university_and_program_options.single_or_multiple_universities: Apply for up to 4 eligible Master's programs across any Swedish universities via University Admissions.
university_and_program_options.university_rankings_scope: Top 100 European research powerhouses and technology institutes.
available_majors: Software Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Cybersecurity, Sustainable Energy Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Biomedical Sciences, Public Health, Environmental Management, Economics, International Development, Sustainable Business
university_and_program_options.admission_requirements_summary: Two-step process: First apply for master's programs on University Admissions Sweden; then apply for the SI scholarship using your application number.
university_and_program_options.easiest_hardest_institutions_guidance: Must be admitted to an eligible program by late March to be awarded the scholarship.
university_and_program_options.strategic_program_match_advice: Check the official SI list of eligible master's programs; select programs that directly correspond to your documented work experience.

application_process_roadmap.portal_system_name: Swedish Institute Online Application Portal
application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Step 1: Apply for master's programs at universityadmissions.se (October to mid-January). Step 2: Apply for SI scholarship on SI portal (mid-February).
step_by_step_workflow: 1. Apply for up to four eligible Master's programs on UniversityAdmissions.se by January 15.

application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Register an applicant profile on the NAWA ICT electronic platform during the open call window.
step_by_step_workflow: 1. Check call announcement on NAWA website and verify eligibility (March).
2. Create account on NAWA ICT system (programs.nawa.gov.pl).
3. Fill in online application form and upload scanned degree certificates, transcripts, and recommendation letter.
4. Submit electronic application before NAWA deadline (mid-May).
5. Apply for academic admission to target Polish university through its university admissions portal (IRK/ESK).
6. Receive NAWA selection evaluation results in July.
7. Apply for Polish National Type D student visa with NAWA decision letter (August-September).
8. Commence studies or preparatory language course on October 1.
